description: In the WooCommerce admin panel (already open in Firefox), create a new manual order. Add the existing product 'Yoga Mat Premium' (1 unit) and the existing product 'Insulated Water Bottle 32oz' (2 units) to the order. Apply the existing coupon code 'WELCOME10' (10% discount) to the order. Set the customer to the existing customer 'John Doe' (john.doe@example.com). Save the order.
